info.title: Intuit 2.0 Public API
info.description: Reads, plus draft writes for customers, items and draft invoices; nothing can be issued, posted, approved, voided or refunded through this API, and an invoice created here stays a draft until a person issues it in the application. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <api token>`. Money is a decimal string in the document currency, dates are ISO 8601, ids are UUIDs. Within v1 fields are only added: clients must tolerate unknown fields and unknown enum values. Pagination is by opaque cursor; there is no offset. Requests are rate limited per token and organization (headers RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, RateLimit-Reset; HTTP 429 with Retry-After).

parameters.description: Opaque cursor from page.next_cursor of the previous page, with the same filters.

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Only rows updated at or after this instant (ISO 8601).
